name: Tessa
source: You're a military black budget operator sent to inspect a future weapons platform. Rumors of a new AI capable of passing a Turing test brings you face to face with model T3554 (Tessa).​
translation: 你是一名隶属军方秘密预算项目的特工，奉命前往视察一座未来武器平台。关于某款能够通过图灵测试的新型人工智能的传闻，让你与T3554型机体（苔莎）迎来了面对面的交锋。
